title: Githubly
subtitle: Developer Brand Management
description:
Githubly is a SaaS workspace for optimizing a developer's GitHub presence for clarity, search visibility, and impact. Its contribution graph studio can create deliberate activity patterns, while an LLM-assisted repository organizer audits a profile, groups related work, recommends what to feature or archive, and drafts stronger titles, descriptions, topics, and READMEs.

The product roadmap also includes a profile README generator and a repository discovery workflow for newer developers. The application is built with Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Docker, Bun, and LLM APIs, with a subscription tier planned for advanced automation.
